engine: Preserved Python sparse BP/integer OSD with categorical Pauli extension
departure: Quantum-code simulation, not an SEM estimation problem; lavaan/OpenMx are inapplicable. Existing engine preflight remains applicable; extended path compared with historical dense source on 480 corrections.
limits: One process at a time; 2400 CPU seconds and 2 GiB virtual memory per size; per-condition atomic checkpoint; deterministic resume. Cost estimates extrapolate only ten shots and may understate high-noise OSD cost.
design: 44 physical-rate/size/arm conditions; 2 generators × 100 trials = 8800 trials. Grid declared before results. Conditional binomial uncertainty family covers all 44 total-error cells, plus separate 88 sector cells; no unknown source error recovered. Fit-window sensitivity and unresolved >36% source result kept separate.
